q: What is the time difference between SU ​​and IP?
a: SU is a short pre-project process; IP is the first full management stage (Initiation).

q: What is the main product of the SU process?
a: Project Brief and Initiation Stage Plan.

q: What is the main product of the IP process?
What is the process behind the Project Board's decision-making?
How many management stages must a PRINCE2 project have?
a: At least two: the Initiation Stage and at least one delivery stage.
The Project Manager, supported by the Executive, during the SU process.

q: Can the project end after the SU process?
a: Yes, if the Project Board determines in the DP process that the project lacks business justification.
Business Case, Project Plan, Management Approaches (Risk, Quality, Communication), Role Structures.
